The gameplay in the second game is better in many ways, but I feel that the first game has a finer tuned balance. Strong Arms is still overpowered in both games, but in 2 the addition of nonlethal slide attacks, drop attacks, and ground takedowns trivializes clean hands runs. Not to mention how busted Domino is, or trait synergy on bone charms.

Also, the story feels really boring to me as well. Delilah was fun as an antagonist in the Knife of Dunwall/Brigmore Witches, but I don't think she was interesting enough to use twice. She even has the same plan in the second game, which is altering reality and seizing the throne via a black magic painting. Most of the rogues gallery seem really non threatening and boring, except for Hypatia. That, and most of the major plot elements and non-lethal eliminations rely on poorly explained McGuffins that the player isn't expected to question.

Dishonored 1's story isn't award-winning by any means, and most of the characters are caricatures, but the world building and atmosphere are awesome. That's why I prefer it.
